name: Weekly survey literature update
queries: ti:"world action" OR abs:"world action" OR ti:"world-action" OR abs:"world-action"
(ti:"world model" OR abs:"world model" OR ti:"video prediction" OR abs:"video prediction") AND (all:robot OR all:robotics OR all:manipulation OR all:embodied OR all:driving OR all:navigation)
(all:"latent action" OR all:"inverse dynamics" OR all:"action-conditioned" OR all:"action conditioned") AND (all:robot OR all:robotics OR all:"world model" OR all:"video model")
(ti:"vision language action" OR ti:"vision-language-action" OR abs:"vision-language-action") AND (all:robot OR all:robotics OR all:embodied)
scope: Read new research directly relevant to world-action models, robot world models, action-conditioned prediction, latent actions, and relevant vision-language-action methods. Include directly relevant datasets, evaluation, simulators and core pretrained components. Mere keyword matches, unrelated applications and generic new surveys are not automatic additions. Apply docs/CLASSIFICATION_REVIEW.md and the current taxonomy; new papers from 2026 onward cannot be Foundational work.
